queryText: query isFeatureEnabled($name: String!, $properties: [FeatureEnabledProperties], $fallback: Boolean) {\n  isFeatureEnabled(name: $name, properties: $properties, fallback: $fallback)\n}

query adminAssemblies($obosCompanyNumber: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $obosCompanyNumber) {
    id
    name
    obosCompanyNumber
    organizationCode
    organizationCodeDescription
    assemblies: generalAssemblies {
      id
      slug
      date
      endDate
      physicalMeetingDate
      phase
      digital
      ordinary
      location
      videoLocation
      year
      ended
      inSession
      createdAt
      createdBy {
        id
        name
      }
    }
  }
}

query generalAssemblyDetails($obosCompanyNumber: OrganizationID!, $slug: String!) {
  generalAssembly(organizationId: $obosCompanyNumber, public: false, slug: $slug) {
    id
    slug
    date
    phase
    endDate
    physicalMeetingDate
    scheduledAt
    location
    videoLocation
    ended
    signed
    ordinary
    digital
    year
    proposalsEndAt
    invitationSentAt
    invitationAttachmentUrl
    protocolAttachmentUrl
    openedForMotions
    preliminaryProtocolUrl
    scheduledAt
    inviteScheduledFor
    createdAt
    textSentAt
    votingPhase
    votingPhaseUpdatedAt
    analogVotes {
      id
      createdAt
      createdBy {
        id
        name
      }
      apartmentNumber
      attachment {
        id
        filename
        url
      }
    }
    assemblyLog {
      createdBy {
        id
        name
      }
      eventType
      url
      createdAt
    }
    assemblyScheduledJobs {
      jobId
      message
      scheduleName
      status
      runAt
    }
    scheduledAt
    motionsClosedAt
    protocolUploadedAt
    createdBy {
      id
      name
    }
    digitalSigning {
      id
      organizationId
      createdAt
      status
      parentId
      parentType
      attachment {
        id
        filename
        url
      }
    }
  }
}

query adminTransferApplicationHistory($organizationId: OrganizationID!) {
  adminTransferApplications(organizationId: $organizationId) {
    ...AdminTransferApplication
  }
  adminTransferApplicationChanges(organizationId: $organizationId) {
    ...AdminTransferApplicationChange
  }
}
fragment AdminTransferApplication on TransferApplication {
  id
  apartmentNumber
  status
  robotStatus
  tenantFirstName
  tenantLastName
  tenantEmail
  tenantPhoneNumber
  tenantBirthDate
  numberOfResidents
  numberOfPets
  isTenantFamily
  hasSelfOrFamilyResided
  description
  contractFrom
  contractTo
  decidedAt
  rejectionReason
  createdAt
  deletedAt
  createdBy {
    id
    name
  }
  decidedBy {
    id
    name
  }
}
fragment AdminTransferApplicationChange on TransferApplicationChange {
  id
  type
  apartmentNumber
  status
  robotStatus
  tenantFirstName
  tenantLastName
  tenantEmail
  tenantPhoneNumber
  tenantBirthDate
  numberOfResidents
  numberOfPets
  isTenantFamily
  hasSelfOrFamilyResided
  description
  contractFrom
  contractTo
  decidedAt
  rejectionReason
  createdAt
  deletedAt
  previousTenantFirstName
  previousTenantLastName
  previousContractTo
  createdBy {
    id
    name
  }
  decidedBy {
    id
    name
  }
}

query SearchDuplicatedUsers($searchDuplicatedUsersInput: SearchDuplicatedUsersInput!) {
  searchDuplicatedUsers(input: $searchDuplicatedUsersInput) {
    userId
    personId
    sub
    auth0Id
    firstName
    lastName
    email
    phoneNumber
    lastActivityAt
    deletedAt
    newsCount
    membershipsCount
    postsCount
    commentsCount
  }
}

query adminMeetingsPage($obosCompanyNumber: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $obosCompanyNumber) {
    id
    name
    obosCompanyNumber
    organizationCode
    organizationCodeDescription
    meetings {
      date
      id
      endDate
      ended
      signed
      location
      lockedForSigning
      createdFromTemplate
    }
    systemContacts {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      jobTitle
      profilePhotoUrl
      phoneNumber
      role
      email
    }
  }
}

query meetingAdmin($id: NodeID!) {
  meeting(id: $id) {
    ...MeetingDetailsAdmin
    ...MeetingMinuteAdmin
    id
    date
    invitationUrl
    ended
    signed
    signedAt
    createdAt
    lockedForSigning
    organization {
      id
      organizationCode
      obosCompanyNumber
    }
  }
}
fragment MeetingDetailsAdmin on Meeting {
  id
  date
  endDate
  location
  videoLocation
  invitationSentAt
  createdFromTemplate
}
fragment MeetingMinuteAdmin on Meeting {
  ...MeetingMinuteSignatureSectionAdmin
  protocolUrl
  attendees {
    id
    name
    email
    shouldSign
    attended
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    invitationSentAt
    memberId
    hasSigned
    member {
      id
      name
      email
      missing
      roles
      personId
    }
  }
  id
  date
  location
  videoLocation
  description
  organization {
    id
  }
}
fragment MeetingMinuteSignatureSectionAdmin on Meeting {
  id
  signed
  lockedForSigning
  viewerHasSigned
  viewerCanSign
  viewerShouldSign
  requiredSignees {
    id
    member {
      id
      missing
      name
    }
    name
  }
  signees {
    id
    missing
    name
  }
}
query inboxUsernameAvailable($organizationId: OrganizationID!, $username: String!) {\n  inboxUsernameAvailable(organizationId: $organizationId, username: $username)\n}

query superSearchCompanyQuery($query: String!) {
  resultCompany: superSearchCompany(query: $query) {
    activeFrom
    activeTo
    cluster {
      mdcHousingCompanyId
      name
      obosCompanyNumber
    }
    generalAssembly
    mdcHousingCompanyId
    housingCompanyName
    smartermailInboxAccount
    housingCompanyNumber
    housingCompanyRoles {
      email
      firstName
      lastName
      mdcPersonId
      phoneNumber
      roleType
      holds {
        holdType
        holdValue
      }
    }
    housingCompanyType
    internalContact {
      email
      firstName
      lastName
      phoneNumber
    }
    invoiceFlow
    isCluster
    nationalOrganizationNumber
    obosKey
    organizationId
    organizationSlug
    housingCompanyEmail
    sourceSystem
    statusFDV
    adviserTeam {
      name
    }
  }
}

query economyBankInformation($organizationId: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $organizationId) {
    id
    systemContacts {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      jobTitle
      role
      email
    }
    accounts {
      type
      name
      accountNumber
      availableAmount
      updatedAt
    }
    loans {
      saldo
      loanType
      bankName
      isObosLoan
      greenLoan
      loanNumber
      loanDescription
      interestRate
      completedPayments
      remainingPayments
      nextPaymentDate
      nextPaymentAmount
      numberOfPayments
      individualPayment
      fixedRate
    }
  }
}
query oldestInvoiceDate($externalCompanyNumber: OrganizationID!) {\n  oldestInvoiceDate(organizationId: $externalCompanyNumber)\n}

query repaymentPlan($organizationNumber: OrganizationID!, $loanType: String!, $loanNumber: String!) {
  organization(id: $organizationNumber) {
    id
    accounts {
      accountNumber
      availableAmount
      name
      type
    }
    loan(loanType: $loanType, loanNumber: $loanNumber) {
      loanNumber
      loanDescription
      loanType
      bankName
      isObosLoan
      greenLoan
      interestRate
      individualPayment
      fixedRate
      nextPaymentDate
      remainingPayments
      numberOfPayments
      saldo
      repaymentPlanTerms {
        termNumber
        dueDate
        deduction
        interest
        fee
        amount
        balance
      }
      repaymentPlanYears {
        year
        deduction
        interest
        fee
        amount
        balance
      }
    }
  }
}

query organizationLoansList($organizationNumber: OrganizationID!) {
  organization(id: $organizationNumber) {

      interestRate

      nextPaymentDate

      numberOfPayments

        termNumber

        deduction
        interest
        fee
        amount
        balance
      }
    }
  }
}

query boardFeesPage($organizationNumber: OrganizationID!, $obosCompanyNumber: ID!) {
  organization(id: $organizationNumber) {
    ...BoardFeesPage_Organization
    boardFees {
      ...BoardFeeTable
    }
  }
  previousBoardMembers(obosCompanyNumber: $obosCompanyNumber) {
    ...BoardFeesPage_PreviousBoardMember
  }
  membersWithCurrentPayments(obosCompanyNumber: $obosCompanyNumber)
}
fragment BoardFeesPage_Organization on Organization {
  id
  obosCompanyNumber
  organizationNumber
  executiveMembers {
    ...BoardFeesPage_Member
  }
}
fragment BoardFeesPage_Member on Member {
  id
  personId
  name
  firstName
  lastName
  profilePhotoUrl
  nationalIdNumber
  email
  phoneNumber
  roles
  hasStyrerommetAccess
  account {
    accountNumber
    confirmed
    confirmedAt
  }
}
fragment BoardFeeTable on BoardFeesDetails {
  id
  createdAt
  createdBy
  attestedAt
  attestedBy
  title
  isDraft
  variant
  viewerHasSigned
  hasAccountValidationIssues
  signed
  updatedAt
  updatedBy {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    name
    profilePhotoUrl
  }
  signatures {
    id
    signedAt
    signedBy {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      name
      profilePhotoUrl
    }
  }
  confirmedAt
  confirmedBy {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    name
    profilePhotoUrl
  }
  permissions {
    viewerHasSignRole
    viewerCanSign
    viewerCanUpdate
    viewerIsUsingBankId
    viewerHasRecentLogin
    viewerCanReject
  }
  payments {
    amount
    name
    personId
    accountNumberConfirmed
    accountNumberChanged
    accountNumberWhenCreated
    accountNumberWhenPaid
    accountNumberEncoded
  }
  draftState {
    payments {
      amount
      personId
      name
      memberId
    }
  }
  totalAmountFromAssembly
  totalAmountFromAssemblyId
  status
  sumPayments
  paymentOrderId
}
fragment BoardFeesPage_PreviousBoardMember on PreviousBoardMember {
  id
  personId
  name
  firstName
  lastName
  profilePhotoUrl
  nationalIdNumber
  email
  phoneNumber
  roles
  hasStyrerommetAccess
  account {
    accountNumber
    confirmed
    confirmedAt
  }
}
query hasPremiumAccess($organizationId: OrganizationID!) {\n  hasPremiumAccess(organizationId: $organizationId)\n}

query kycFormStatus($organizationId: OrganizationID!) {
  kycFormStatus(organizationId: $organizationId) {
    ...KycFormStatusFields
  }
}
fragment KycFormStatusFields on KycFormStatus {
  canDismiss
  hasNewBoardMembersSinceSubmission
  requiresRedirect
  activeForm {
    ...KycFormFields
  }
}
fragment KycFormFields on KycForm {
  id
  organizationId
  submittedAt
  firstDismissedAt
  lastDismissedAt
  createdAt
  customerOrdinaryBanking
  customerOrdinaryBankingDetails
  customerLoanEquity
  customerLoanEquityDetails
  customerForeignReceive
  customerForeignReceiveDetails
  customerForeignReceiveCountry
  customerForeignReceiveAmount
  customerForeignSend
  customerForeignSendDetails
  customerForeignSendCountry
  customerForeignSendAmount
  customerExtraCash
  customerExtraCashDetails
  customerExtraCashAmount
  ownerJob
  ownerJobDetails
  ownerHasOwnership
  ownerHasOwnershipDetails
}

query userWithoutOrganizationQuery {
    viewer {
      id
      name
      firstName
      personId
      lastName
      phoneNumber
      email

      admin
      developer
      styrerommetDebugger
      flags
      profilePhotoUrl
    }
  }

query userWithOrganizationQuery($obosCompanyNumber: OrganizationID!) {
    viewer {
      id
      name
      firstName
      personId
      lastName
      hasHousingCompanyRoles
      # email / phoneNumber is queried from viewerAsMember

      admin
      developer
      flags
      profilePhotoUrl
    }

    organization(id: $obosCompanyNumber) {
      id
      status
      obosCompanyNumber
      organizationNumber
      name
      slug
      obosEnabled
      onProperty
      apartmentsCount
      modulesAvailable
      intendedForTest
      organizationCode
      isHBEF
      usesSmarterMail

      viewerAsMember {
        id
        userId
        phoneNumber
        email
        roles
        permissions
      }
    }
  }
